panels.title: Queue Wait P50/P90/P99
panels.description: How long scrapes waited behind an agent's other scrapes before its stream took them (proxy_scrape_queue_wait_seconds). When latency climbs and this climbs with it, the agent is busy.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, path) (rate(proxy_scrape_request_latency_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", path=~"$path"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Agent Disconnects by Reason
panels.description: Agents the proxy removed: eviction (no contact within maxAgentInactivitySecs), termination (connection closed), stream_terminated (transportFilterDisabled).

panels.title: Late Scrape Results
panels.description: Results that arrived after their scrape had ended, usually at a timeout the scrape was already counted for.

panels.title: Agent Auth Failures by Reason
panels.description: Agent calls refused for a missing or unknown token. An agent with a wrong token reconnects every few seconds.

panels.title: Path Rejections by Cause
panels.description: Every refused path registration, retries included, by the cause the agent is told.

panels.title: Binding Mismatches by RPC
panels.description: Agent calls naming another agent or identity than their connection's. Zero for the stock agent.

panels.title: Dashboard Logins by Outcome
panels.description: Sign-ins on the login page (success), wrong logins (failure), and logins refused for the limit on wrong ones (blocked).
